articles.summary: Retail sugar price has dropped 3.85% to ₹62.57 per kg in a week, data from the Consumer Affairs Ministry showed. The slight drop follows recent government measures, including allowing imports and tightening of stockholding norms for dealers.

articles.title: Delivery, ride-hailing and home services — Gig workers earn 2.5x compared to similar formal and informal jobs: Report

articles.title: Ahead of festive season, what is silver hallmarking? Here's how to spot and read the classifications
articles.summary: Silver hallmarking enables buyers to verify purity or fineness of precious metal jewellery. At present, the process remains voluntary for silver jewellery since 2005 but has been mandatory for gold since June 2021.

articles.summary: Securing an individual insurance policy around age 25 while in good health unlocks financial and structural perks, including lower starting premiums and the ability to clear required waiting periods before medical issues arise.

articles.title: Pulse of the Street: US bond yields, interest rate jitters drag Indian equities lower this week
articles.summary: Indian equities fell about 1% this week as higher US Treasury yields, elevated crude prices and foreign selling weighed on sentiment. Friday’s recovery offered little relief, with valuations, IPO supply and shifting rate expectations keeping investors cautious for the week ahead.

articles.title: NSE IPO listing date, timeline: When ₹30,000 cr issue is expected to hit Indian stock market exchanges
articles.summary: The NSE IPO, approved by Sebi, is set to raise around ₹30,000 crore, surpassing previous IPO records. Offering 149 million shares from existing shareholders, the IPO marks a significant milestone after years of delays due to regulatory issues and is expected to list in September 2024.
